ellipse.style: stroke: rgb(0, 0, 0); paint-order: fill; fill-rule: evenodd; fill: none; stroke-width: 26px;

rect.style: fill: none; stroke-width: 26px; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke: rgb(0, 0, 0);

path.style: stroke: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill: none; stroke-width: 26px; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round;
